messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 44):
"""
31) IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/046/03/2022 dated 07.03.2022 Disclosure of underwriting philosophy 32) IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/102/5/2022 dated 23.05.2022 Modification of Returns on standardization of health insurance products under the circular dated 22.7.2020. 33) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/104/5/2022 dated 27.05.2022 Modification of definitions issued under the circular dated22.7.2020. 34) IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/102/5/2022 dated 23.5.2022 Revision of Health Insurance Regulatory Returns 35) IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/150/7/2022 dated 20.7.2022 Standards and Benchmarks for the Hospitals in the Provider Network 45 36) IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/190/9/2022 dated 13.9.2022 Revision of Health Insurance Regulatory Returns 37) IRDAI/ HLT/ CIR/ MISC/ 123/ 06/2023 dated 08.06.2023 Creation of facility to capture ABHA number of proposers 38) IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/190/10/2023 dated 30.10.2023 Revision of Customer Information Sheet 39) IRDAI/HLT/CIR/GDL/31/01/2024 dated 31.01.2024 Guidelines on providing AYUSH coverage in Health Insurance policies.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"When was the IRDAI circular on providing AYUSH coverage in health insurance policies issued?","answer":"The circular on providing AYUSH coverage was issued on 31.01.2024.","facts":["IRDAI/HLT/CIR/GDL/31/01/2024 dated 31.01.2024 Guidelines on providing AYUSH coverage in Health Insurance policies"]},{"question":"Which IRDAI circular introduced the facility to capture the ABHA number of proposers?","answer":"The facility to capture ABHA numbers was introduced in the circular dated 08.06.2023.","facts":["IRDAI/ HLT/ CIR/ MISC/ 123/ 06/2023 dated 08.06.2023 Creation of facility to capture ABHA number of proposers"]}]}
